decision.reason: Hold: the prior review was only 3,808 seconds ago, below the required two-hour cooldown, despite sufficient paid sales. Two food candidates now have an actual food_trial_shelf_policy rejection, but this is a code-level bottleneck that no tunable parameter is shown to fix. Eligible candidates remain available, while capital support has weakened and the mature pre/post evaluation shows lower after-window settlements and acquisition spread; it is observational and spread is not net profit.
decision.expected_effect: Preserves the current policy while avoiding an unsupported expansion or parameter change until the cooldown passes and the food shelf-policy bottleneck can be evaluated separately.
evidence: 30 candidates are eligible; 2 are blocked by the observed food_trial_shelf_policy rejection.
Seconds since prior change: 3,808, below the required 7,200 seconds.
Available to invest is 4,967,853 versus the 12,000,000 window budget, so the budget is already capital-constrained.
Mature equal windows show 54 versus 36 settlements and acquisition spread of 541,182 versus 398,415; attribution is explicitly non-causal and excludes holding/refunds.
Reported category, stock-ceiling, threshold, trial-window, buyer-guard, and forum limits remain unmeasured unless tied to actual rejection reasons.
